To do this correctly, I will need to interpret the SMILES string and identify key structural features such as functional groups, ring systems, and stereochemistry. I can then compare these features to each option's description to find the best match.

- The string ends with "CCN1C(OCC)=O", indicating an ethyl ester group (OCC).
